name: vscode-staging
title: Compare staged and unstaged versions of one file in VS Code

callouts.label: The selected snapshot is under Staged Changes
The same file also has a later unstaged edit under Changes

name: vscode-conflict
title: Compare both inputs and edit the merge result in VS Code

callouts.label: README is listed under Merge Changes until its conflict is resolved
Read both Incoming and Current versions before choosing the result
Edit Result to preserve both degrees and shortest-arc meaning
Complete Merge stages the resolved file; review, test and commit afterward

name: vscode-undo
title: Inspect retained work after Undo Last Commit in VS Code

callouts.label: README remains staged after undoing the private commit
The staged diff retains the radians line so it can be corrected

name: vscode-revert
title: Inspect a shared mistake followed by its revert in VS Code

callouts.label: The new revert is a separate commit at the top of Graph
The original shared mistake remains in the recorded history
The log shows local and practice remote branches at the new revert
Check the README still records the corrected angle units
